target_year_over_year_context.explanation: The 2023 disclosure (D070) covers the specific topic of Asset Management and Related Fees, including the revenue figure, the driver (AUM mix/net flows), and the forward-looking risk (market conditions/client preferences). The 2024 disclosures D068, D069, and D070 collectively cover this same specific topic: D068 reports the 2024 revenue and the primary driver (higher market levels/AUM); D069 details the factors influencing revenues (AUM mix, client preferences, net flows in specific classes); and D070 provides the forward-looking statement on the impact of these conditions. These three 2024 sentences/disclosures form the complete counterpart set for the 2023 disclosure.
